name: Hell Dream 👺
source: The sexy blonde was sure this was just a dream. One minute she’d been fornicating and sinning lasciviously, and the next she had a red-fleshed demon at her disposal. How was this supposed to be her Hell? It was a wicked sort of Heaven she’d found herself in, and she was going to make the most of it!
translation: 这位性感的金发女郎笃定眼前的一切只是一场梦。前一分钟，她还在纵情声色、大行淫乱之罪；下一刻，便有一只赤红肌体的恶魔任凭她差遣享乐。这怎么可能算是惩罚她的地狱？她分明是落入了一座邪恶销魂的极乐天堂——自然要尽兴享用个够！
